'''Hero Ferrari''' is an [[Engineers|Odyssey Engineer]] based at '''Nevermore Terrace''' in the '''Siris''' system. Little is known of her history, and she is widely believed to work under a pseudonym. She specialises in military-grade suit mobility and handheld-weapon handling.<ref name="edwiki-hero">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Hero_Ferrari Hero Ferrari], Elite Dangerous Wiki; in-game biography and legacy service record. Retrieved 11 September 2026.</ref>

Ferrari is an independent starting Engineer: she is common knowledge and does not require a referral from another Engineer.<ref name="inara-hero">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/28/ Hero Ferrari — Engineer], INARA; current access, referral, and modification record. Retrieved 11 September 2026.</ref>

Nevermore Terrace is a surface Engineer base on Siris 5 c, approximately 1,515 Ls from the system arrival point.<ref name="inara-nevermore">[https://inara.cz/elite/station/242745/ Nevermore Terrace — Station], INARA; current facility and location record. Retrieved 11 September 2026.</ref>

! Requirement
|-

The requirement applies to on-foot surface conflicts rather than ship Combat Zones. The complete ordered process belongs to [[Unlocking Hero Ferrari]].<ref name="inara-hero" />

{{Field note|INARA reports that station services may not appear immediately after the workshop is unlocked. Relogging should make them available.<ref name="inara-hero" />}}

== Odyssey Engineering ==

Ferrari installs individual modifications into available suit and handheld-weapon modification slots. Her services do not use the Grade 1–5 Engineer-reputation progression, blueprint rolls, Experimental Effects, or Remote Engineering used for ship modules. Equipment grade and modification-slot availability are handled through the wider [[Odyssey Engineering]] system.

== Engineering services ==

{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Modification
! Equipment
! Purpose
|-
| Faster Handling
| Handheld weapon
| Reduces weapon draw and stow time and improves aiming-down-sights handling.
|-
| Noise Suppressor
| Handheld weapon
| Reduces the sound produced when firing in pressurised environments.
|-
| Improved Jump Assist
| Suit
| Extends the operating duration of the suit's Jump Assist system.
|-
| Increased Air Reserves
| Suit
| Increases emergency life-support time after suit energy is depleted.
|-
| Increased Sprint Duration
| Suit
| Reduces exhaustion during sustained sprinting.
|}

These five modifications are available once Ferrari is unlocked, subject to compatible equipment, an open modification slot, and the required Odyssey materials and credits.<ref name="inara-hero" /> Their complete recipes and cross-Engineer availability belong to [[Odyssey Engineer Modifications]].

== Direct referral ==

Ferrari provides the referral to [[Wellington Beck]]. After unlocking her workshop, deliver '''5 Settlement Defence Plans''' to Ferrari to receive that referral.<ref name="inara-hero" /><ref name="inara-wellington">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/30/ Wellington Beck — Engineer], INARA; current referral relationship. Retrieved 11 September 2026.</ref>

Frontier reduced this requirement from 15 plans to 5 in Update 18.08.<ref name="frontier-1808">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-0-18-08 Type-8 Update Release Notes (18.08)], Frontier Developments; revised Odyssey Engineer requirements. Retrieved 11 September 2026.</ref>
